comments.value:
Thanks for capturing these affected worlds and UI requests. The team has reviewed these items and here are our thoughts. Closing this ticket as we'll track the approved items individually.
    *Press*: Couldn't find a matching event, not sure what they're trying to do.
    *SendMessage*: Not allowed since you can use it to call arbitrary messages.
    *BroadcastMessage*: Same as SendMessage.
    *RectTransform.SetParent*: Would need an example of how this is used via UI, seems like a much better candidate for UdonBehaviour.
    *Animator.enabled*: Coming in following release.
    *VRCPickup.PlayHaptics*: Use UdonBehaviour with VRCPickup.PlayHaptics or VRCPlayerApi.PlayHapticEventInHand.
    *Animator.Update*: Need to see an example of how this is used.
    *TextMeshPro.text*: Working on adding TMPro to Udon, will whitelist this method.
    *TextMeshProUGUI.text*: Considering TextMeshProUGUI for inclusion, would be later as it will take more work to implement our UI filtering here as well.
    *UdonBehaviour.OnPickupUseDown*,
    *UdonBehaviour.OnPickupUseUp*,
   *UdonBehaviour.OnStationEntered*,
    *UdonBehaviour.OnStationExited*,
    *UdonBehaviour.OnVideoStart*: These events should be triggered by the actual actions.

@{5de9405aea7cc52772fcc359|full_name}: 
Press event is often used for triggering uGUI button(witch defines next action) from Animation on SDK2.
For example, even VRC_Starter Kit ( https://booth.pm/ja/items/979837 ) uses Button.Press event on SDK2.
It makes SDK2->SDK3 migration easier. Without it, we need reimplement uGUI Buttons like above by UdonBehavior to make it work on SDK3.
@{5f2cc2f6c00297464bd2e59c|full_name}: Thank you for the explanation. These will continue to work in SDK2 but we are forging a new path for SDK3.
